description: Exact product-efficiency, diminishing-power, unbounded canonical, and homogeneous-sum cancellation dichotomy

exact_quantifiers.products: every finite weighted product of P_h(n) or scalar C_h(n), with h>=2 and arbitrary K=K(n)
exact_quantifiers.sums: every nonzero homogeneous integer-coefficient sum of primitive product monomials; coefficients and gaps must be specified independently of target factorization for admission
exact_quantifiers.target: every positive divisor Q of q_n, including every Item265 de-overlapped surviving target Q|qbar_(m,n)

open: an actual-family high-efficiency or weighted return-cover theorem
a prime-independent homogeneous sum with proved target cancellation divisibility
nonhomogeneous sums and arbitrary growing block/Hankel determinants
the uniform v_p(q_n) log p=O(n) theorem or sufficient little-oh aggregate
the clearing-divisor and transverse matching correlation
Route 1 and every conclusion about e+pi

theorem.canonical_capacity: an O(n)-height canonical portfolio has only O(n/log n) certified log depth, uniformly over odd primes
theorem.canonical_unbounded_optimum: minimum anti-period certified gap cost for depth s is s(p-1), attained by s repeated depth-one factors
theorem.deoverlap: all target statements apply after choosing Q|q_n/gcd(q_n,D_m)
theorem.efficiency_dichotomy: captured_log/H is at most the largest primitive overlap efficiency log gcd(Q,P_h)/log P_h
theorem.height_and_multiplicity: H=O(n) implies L=O(n/log n) and K<=L=O(n/log n)
theorem.power_layers: for G_t=gcd(Q,P_h^t), the new layers G_t/G_(t-1) form a divisibility-decreasing chain
theorem.scope_limit: actual high-efficiency short returns and tied-minimum cancellation are not excluded
theorem.sum_dichotomy: a unique least term valuation gives no cancellation depth; only tied minima can create a new sum-only factor
